governance_note: State whether the matrix is a discrete-time update, continuous-time generator, or local Jacobian.
Use unit-circle tests for discrete time and real-part tests for continuous time.
Define the equilibrium, baseline, trajectory, distribution, or operating region being evaluated.
Review whether stable, unstable, and dominant modes are well separated.
Check whether transient growth could matter despite asymptotic decay.
Explain what stability means for the domain; stable does not automatically mean desirable.
